# Allowlist for the private-info check: generic-pattern matches that are known
# to be safe (fictional test fixtures, documentation examples).
#
# Format: <file>:<value>, or *:<value> to allow the value in every file.
# Known fictional values (the fictional org number 556677-8899, IBAN
# registry examples) are built into scripts/check-private-info.ts already.
#
# Never add real names, real org numbers, real IPs or real domains. This file
# is itself scanned against the denylist, and every PR that edits it is
# flagged in the job output for review.
